This week, we are working with the Totally Serious Pop Culture Research Institute™ to answer six questions about pop culture. For every study, use $\alpha = 0.05$. Choose the appropriate categorical test, check its conditions, and interpret the result in context.

Let's call in the packages and data we need,

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ssstats)

popcorn_flavor <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-popcorn_flavor.csv")
streaming_genre <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-streaming_genre.csv")
spoiler_platform <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-spoiler_platform.csv")
costume_fandom <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-costume_fandom.csv")
trailer_rewatch <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-trailer_rewatch.csv")
meme_caption <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M3-meme_caption.csv")
```
